part.text: The fallback parser converts ISO fields to floats, then interpolates the fractional remainder into `fromString()`. At microsecond precision, a tiny binary-float error becomes scientific notation, which the duration parser rejects. I’ll round only the second remainder to Carbon’s six-digit microsecond precision.
